snippet.title: Tetris Attack - Nintendo Power Previews 15 segment
snippet.description:
If you liked this feel free to give the original Laserdisc ripper your support. His YouTube is here, and you can watch the entire unedited disc here:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCr4hZ7caTBhztLht7B4s7wg

I've been following these for some time, and am actually bummed out it doesn't get more attention! Maybe I can help there by showing some things from them. This way, one doesn't necessarily have to watch the entire videos to find certain parts or deal with the amount of repeat and redundant footage.

Much like the first round of Donkey Kong GB footage, this version of Tetris Attack has a proto title screen logo that looks very plain compared to what we got later on. There likely aren't any gameplay differences considering this was a modification of Panel de Pon from the get go, but I do wonder if there are early versions of the "Localization" work that was being done. #Shorts
